title: Three years of genocide in Gaza through one man’s camera
english: For nearly three years, Ibrahim Rabaa has documented his harrowing experiences living through the ongoing conflict in Gaza. His personal video collection serves as a witness to the relentless bombardment and frequent displacement he and others have faced. These recordings provide a raw, firsthand account of a devastating war that has resulted in the deaths of over 73,000 Palestinians.
amharic: ኢብራሂም ረባ በጋዛ ለሦስት ዓመታት ያህል በቀጠለው ጦርነት ውስጥ ያሳለፈውን አሰቃቂ ህይወት በካሜራው ሲመዘግብ ቆይቷል። የእርሱ የግል የቪዲዮ ምስሎች የቦምብ ጥቃቶችን እና ተደጋጋሚ መፈናቀልን እንደ ምስክርነት ያሳያሉ። እነዚህ የተቀረጹ ምስሎች ከ73,000 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወት የቀጠፈውን አሰቃቂ ጦርነት እውነታ በግልፅ ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Ibraahim Raabaa waggoota sadii oliif waraana Gaazaa keessatti muuxannoo isaa suuraa fi viidiyoon waraabaa ture. Viidiyoon kun miidhaa dhukaasaa fi buqqee namoota biroo irratti ga'uuf ragaa dha. Viidiyoon kun lola lubbuu namoota Palastiinii 73,000 olii galaafate kana akka ragaa dhuunfaa tokkootti tajaajila.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli forces arrest school children during raid
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid in the occupied West Bank that resulted in the arrest of several school children while their parents begged the soldiers to stop. During the same period, Israeli official Ben-Gvir suggested the controversial idea of sending Palestinians to other nations to reduce defense spending. These events highlight the ongoing tensions and human rights concerns in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ባደረጉት ወረራ በርካታ የትምህርት ቤት ተማሪዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል፤ ወላጆችም ልጆቻቸው እንዳይታሰሩ ወታደሮቹን ሲለምኑ ታይተዋል። በተመሳሳይ ወቅት፣ እስራኤላዊው ባለስልጣን ቤን-ግቪር የመከላከያ በጀትን ለመቆጠብ ፍልስጤማውያንን ወደ ሌሎች አገራት መሸጥ እንደሚቻል ተናግረዋል። እነዚህ ክስተቶች በአካባቢው ያለውን ከፍተኛ ውጥረት እና የሰብአዊ መብት ስጋቶችን ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaafi Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin barattoota mana barumsaa hedduu hidhaniiru; warri ijoollee kunneenis akka hin hidhamne waraana kadhachaa turan. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, aangawaan Israa'el Ben-Gvir baajata ittisa biyyattii xiqqeessuuf jecha Palastinoonni gara biyyoota biraatti akka ergaman yaada wal-falmisiisaa ta'e dhiyeesseera. Taateewwan kun naannichatti rakkoo nageenyaafi mirga namoomaa jiru kan mul'isaniidha.

title: Philippines arrests 244 suspects in online scam crackdown
english: Philippine authorities recently conducted a major operation in Mindanao, arresting 244 foreign nationals linked to illegal offshore gaming centers. These facilities were reportedly used by criminal groups as fronts for various illicit activities, including fraud and human trafficking. The government is now investigating these individuals for potential crimes and plans to deport those involved as part of a national effort to shut down these prohibited operations.
amharic: የፊሊፒንስ ባለስልጣናት በቅርቡ በሚንዳናኦ ደሴት ባደረጉት የተቀናጀ ኦፕሬሽን ህገ-ወጥ የኦንላይን ቁማር ማዕከላትን ሲያካሂዱ የነበሩ 244 የውጭ ሀገር ዜጎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እነዚህ ማዕከላት የወንጀል ቡድኖች ለሰዎች ዝውውር እና ለተለያዩ ማጭበርበሮች መሸፈኛነት ይጠቀሙባቸው እንደነበር ተገልጿል። መንግስት በተያዙት ሰዎች ላይ የወንጀል ምርመራ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ህገ-ወጥ ስራዎችን ለመከላከል በሚደረገው ጥረት መሰረትም ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ ይደረጋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Filippiins mudannoo gurguddaa magaalaa Mindanao keessatti geggeesseen, namoota biyya alaa 244 bakkaalee daadoo toora intarneetii seeraan alaa ta'an keessatti hojjechaa turan to'annoo jala oolcheera. Bakkaaleen kun garee yakkaatiin akka iddoo nama gurguruu fi hojii gowwoomsuuf itti fayyadaman himatameera. Mootummaan namoota kana irratti qorannoo yakkaa gaggeessaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, hojii seeraan alaa kana dhaabsisuuf jecha namoota kunneen biyyatti deebisuuf qophiirra jira.

title: Portugal vs Norway live – UEFA Nations League
english: Portugal is set to host Norway at the Estadio do Dragao in Porto for a 2026-27 UEFA Nations League Group A4 fixture. As the defending champions, Portugal will look to secure a victory on home soil. The match is scheduled to begin at 7:45pm local time.
amharic: ፖርቹጋል በ2026-27 የዩኢኤፍኤ ኔሽንስ ሊግ የምድብ A4 ጨዋታ ኖርዌይን በፖርቶ የኢስታዲዮ ዶ ድራጋኦ ስታዲየም ትጋብዛለች። የውድድሩ ባለቤት የሆነችው ፖርቹጋል በሜዳዋ ድል ለማግኘት ትጥራለች። ጨዋታው በሀገር ውስጥ ሰዓት አቆጣጠር ከምሽቱ 1:45 ላይ ይጀምራል።
oromo: Portugal tapha UEFA Nations League kan bara 2026-27 garee A4 keessatti Norway istaadiyeemii Estadio do Dragao kan Porto jiruutti keessummeessiti. Tapha kana qopheessituun qophii dursaa taatee kan jirtu Portugal, bakka ishee kanatti injifannoo argachuuf halkii qabdi. Taphi kun sa'aatii naannoo 1:45 irratti ni jalqaba.

title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
english: Russian drone strikes have targeted major bridges in Kyiv for four days in a row, causing injuries and significant traffic disruptions for the city's residents. These attacks on vital infrastructure coincided with a surprise visit from German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, who traveled to the capital to demonstrate his support for Ukraine. Local officials are working to repair the damage and explore alternative transportation methods to keep the city connected despite the ongoing military pressure.
amharic: የሩሲያ ድሮኖች ለተከታታይ አራት ቀናት በኪየቭ ዋና ዋና ድልድዮች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር ጉዳት ያደረሱ ሲሆን በከተማዋ የትራፊክ መጨናነቅ እንዲፈጠር አድርገዋል። እነዚህ ወሳኝ መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች የጀርመን ቻንስለር ፍሬድሪች ሜርዝ ድጋፋቸውን ለመግለጽ ባደረጉት ድንገተኛ ጉብኝት ወቅት ነው የተከሰቱት። የከተማዋ አስተዳደር ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ድልድዮች ለመጠገን እና ህዝቡን ለማገናኘት አማራጭ የመጓጓዣ መንገዶችን ለመዘርጋት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa guyyoota afur walitti aansuun buufataalee gurguddaa magaalaa Kiyiv irratti haleellaa drooniin raawwateen namoonni miidhamanii fi tajaajilli geejjibaas gufatee jira. Haleellaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa kanaa irratti raawwatame kun, kan mudate yeroo kansoolariin Jarman Fireediriik Meerz deeggarsa isaanii ibsuuf gara magaalaattishee taa'itti daawwannaa tasaa taasisanitti dha. Bulchiinsi magaalaas miidhaa qaqqabe suphuu fi namoota nagaaf tajaajila geejjibaa bakka bu'uuf karoorfataa jiru.

title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
english: Australian authorities are investigating the background of an Omani co-pilot who attacked his captain with an axe during a Flydubai flight to Israel. The pilot was able to regain control with the help of passengers, and the plane landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Officials are now examining the suspect’s previous time studying in Australia to determine if he was radicalized while living in the country.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ባለሥልጣናት ከዱባይ ወደ እስራኤል በሚበር አውሮፕላን ላይ ካፒቴኑን በመጥረቢያ ያጠቃውን የኦማን ተወላጅ ረዳት አብራሪ ዳራ እያጣሩ ነው። ተሳፋሪዎች በተረባረቡበት ወቅት አውሮፕላኑ በሳውዲ አረቢያ በሰላም ማረፍ ችሏል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ጥርጣሬ ያለበት ግለሰብ በአውስትራሊያ ቆይታው ወቅት አክራሪነት ውስጥ ገብቶ እንደነበር ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa qondaala balaliisaa biyya Omaan kan ta'e fi balaliii Dubaayii gara Israa'elitti imala turerratti kapteena isaa qottoon haleele sana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira. Imaltoonni birmannaa gochuun ajajichi gara Sa'udii Arabiyaatti nagaadhaan akka qubatu taasisaniiru. Qondaalonni mootummaa shakkamaan kun yeroo Awustiraaliyaa keessa barataa turetti yaada hammeenyaa qabatee akka ture qorachaa jiru.

title: Russia hits Kyiv bridge as Germany’s Merz visits Ukraine’s capital
english: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv to reaffirm Germany's commitment to Ukraine, despite ongoing Russian missile and drone attacks on the city. During his trip, Russia struck a major bridge in the capital, highlighting the volatile security situation. The visit focused on strengthening defense cooperation, including plans for joint weapon manufacturing and the announcement of a new military and energy aid package.
amharic: የጀርመኑ ቻንስለር ፍሬድሪክ ሜርዝ በዩክሬን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የሩሲያ ጥቃት በመቋቋም የጀርመንን ድጋፍ ለማረጋገጥ ወደ ኪየቭ ተጉዘዋል። የጉብኝቱ ወቅት ሩሲያ በከተማዋ በሚገኝ ዋና ድልድይ ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘረችበት ቢሆንም፣ መሪዎቹ በጋራ የጦር መሳሪያ ምርት እና በአዲስ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ጥቅል ላይ ተወያይተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት ለዩክሬን የተሰጠው አዲስ የጦር እና የኢነርጂ ዘርፍ ድጋፍ ይፋ የተደረገበትም ጭምር ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Jarman Friedrich Merz, weerara Raashiyaan magaalaa Kiyev irratti geggeessaa jirtu keessa iyyuu deggarsa biyyi isaanii qabdu ibsuuf gara magaalaatti imalaniiru. Imala isaanii kana keessa Raashiyaan daandii gurguddaa magaalaa Kiyev keessaa tokko kan ta'e riqicha irratti haleellaa geggeessiteerti. Hoggantoonni kunneen haala waldoota waraanaa cimsuu fi deggarsa lolaa fi anniisaa haaraa biyyi Jarman qopheessite irratti mari'ataniiru.
